text:
leo: Nebula POC stalled. Customer seeing 429 on embeddings and 403 invalid_project intermittently when switching endpoints.

anika: can you paste the exact request and response headers/log snippet?

leo: they shared two errors. First:

Request: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_poc_NEBULA' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rw-embed-medium","input":["a","b"]}'

Response: 429 {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":2}

Second (after retrying): 403 {"error":"invalid_project","message":"project proj-xyz not available for key"}

chuck: 429 + 403 combo usually means they're hitting per-project rate limits while also using a key bound to a different project/org. If they retried too fast, we return 429; if key mismatches, 403.

billing-bot: NOTE: account nebula-corp currently has no billing method on file; trial quota is limited to 5000 tokens/day. Add billing to raise quotas.

anika: ask them to check two things: 1) which key is being used (project vs org key) and 2) project-level quotas and billing. Also run keys lookup (no secret in chat):

curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_lookup_REDACTED' "https://console.redwood.ai/v1/keys/lookup?token=sk_poc_NEBULA"

leo: they ran lookup and it shows the key is project-scoped to proj-old, not proj-demo they created for POC. That explains invalid_project. They were also using an SDK that spammed requests during a bulk upload. :/ 

sec-bot: SECURITY: avoid pasting full keys. share only last-4 or use lookup tokens.

chuck: remediation steps provided to customer:
- create a new project-scoped service key under proj-demo with embeddings + generate scopes
- review quota in Console -> Projects -> proj-demo -> Quotas; request quota increase or add billing
- ensure SDK config uses that new key and only sets X-Redwood-Project (remove X-Redwood-Org) to avoid conflicts
- add exponential backoff for transient 429s

leo: customer created new proj-demo key and added billing card. After switching key and backing off retries they see 200s again. :partying_face: 

anika: will update POC checklist: include 'billing required for >trial quota', 'key lookup command', 'header precedence', and 'backoff sample snippet'.

leo: closing POC and emailing Nebula the checklist. thanks team.
